benchmark.scope: Constructed RU/EN skill-selection corpus and pinned OpenRouter API baseline; not whole-workflow or subscription savings. Per-case latencies were not recorded in this run; wallSeconds is the actual executed-command duration.

nativeSmoke.scope: Actual SDK session + official print-mode initializeExtensions, actual main-model turn and installed native extension with validated temporary v2 policy. JEV callback input/output prefix audited unchanged; unrelated SDK/plugin dynamic prompt changes explicitly observed. Credential-unavailable and transport-unavailable boundaries were injected without changing OS credentials. Secret and opt-out paths used actual native dispatcher.
